_readme: Site-wide settings: the header, the home page's hero, the footer and downloads. basePath is where GitHub Pages serves the site; 404.html uses it so its links work from any address.
title: AI-First Design Workshop
description: A hands-on evening for designers with UXPA Seattle: Thursday, November 19, 5:30 to 8:30 PM in Seattle. Set up VS Code Insiders, then take Excalidraw from a marked-up screenshot to four directions, a demo video and a live link.
footer: An independent community event with UXPA Seattle. Not an official Microsoft or GitHub event.
Excalidraw is open source under the MIT license, and we're not affiliated with the Excalidraw team.
